answer: LIST st, ci, zi, sta FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO (g / t) AS er AND ALSO has SchoolStreet st AND ALSO has SchoolCity ci AND ALSO has SchoolZip zi AND ALSO has SchoolState sta ORDERED WITH er ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST s FROM Frpm [has SchoolDOC: '31'] has SchoolSchool s AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e ORDERED WITH e DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School has SchoolGSoffered g AND ALSO has SchoolLongitude lo AND ALSO abs(lo) AS a ORDERED WITH a DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, d FROM Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has SchoolSchool n AND ALSO has SchoolDOC d AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a AND ALSO (k - a) AS diff WHERE diff > THE AVERAGE v IN (Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2 AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2 AND ALSO (k2 - a2) AS v)
LIST n FROM Satscore has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmFreeMealCountK12 fm AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e AND ALSO (fm / e) AS pct AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE pct > 0.1 AND g > 0
LIST c, n FROM School s [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty c AND ALSO THE COUNT OF s GROUPED BY c AS n WHERE c = 'San Diego' OR c = 'Santa Barbara' ORDERED WITH n DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
